form:FormGroup.label: Expression
form:FormGroup.helpText: Selects the received data this rule applies to, using its header attributes. The first matching rule's action is used; data that matches no rule is rejected.

form:FormGroup.label: Rule Name (optional)
form:FormGroup.helpText: An optional name to help you tell rules apart. It does not affect which data the rule matches.

form:FormGroup.label: Action
form:FormGroup.helpText: What to do with matching data. Receive accepts it, Reject returns an error to the sender, and Drop discards it silently while still reporting success.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Receive, Reject (sender gets an error) or Drop (silently discarded).
